Bar Council Reverses Order Barring NALSAR Graduates' Enrolment

The Bar Council of India (BCI) initially suspended the enrolment of NALSAR University's 2026 graduating class. This action followed a protest by students who boycotted the convocation ceremony where the Chief Justice of India was invited. The BCI cited "groupism and dirty politics" and a "cockroach" protest threat. However, following criticism and a U-turn, the BCI withdrew its order, with its chairman stating that "most students are innocent." The modified order allows state bar councils to enrol the NALSAR graduates.
